notes: Campbell adopted the Envision Campbell General Plan in 2024, which introduced new land use designations and form-based zoning (Multi-Family Development and Design Standards, MFDDS).

The city's zoning code (Title 21) maps zoning districts to General Plan land use designations via Table 2-1. The density ranges listed here correspond to the General Plan land use designations as published in the 2024 General Plan GIS layer.
Residential zoning districts include R-1 (Single-Family), R-M-S (Multiple-Family), and mixed-use zones. The form-based approach uses GP designation densities as the controlling standard.
Density is expressed in dwelling units per gross acre (du/ac).
For zones with no explicit minimum density, min_density is set to 0. State law (SB 166/No Net Loss) may impose effective minimums on housing element sites.
